source: NCSA National Information Assurance Standard V2.1 (May 2023): IDs only, no NCSA text

domains.name: Security Governance
domains.summary: Who owns information security, with what authority, support and budget.

domains.name: Risk Management
domains.summary: Assessing information risks, treating them and checking that the treatment works.

domains.name: Third Party Security Management
domains.summary: Keeping security accountable and visible when services are outsourced.

domains.name: Data Classification Label
domains.summary: Labelling information so its handling matches its sensitivity.

domains.name: Change Management
domains.summary: Controlled, approved and documented changes to systems.

domains.name: Personnel Security
domains.summary: Security before, during and after employment, for staff and visitors.

domains.name: Security Awareness
domains.summary: Training and awareness so people know and follow security expectations.

domains.name: Incidents Management
domains.summary: Detecting, reporting, handling and learning from security incidents.

domains.name: Business Continuity Management
domains.summary: Keeping critical services running through disruption and recovering them.

domains.name: Logging and Security Monitoring
domains.summary: Recording and watching activity so misuse is noticed and traceable.

domains.name: Data Retention and Archival
domains.summary: Keeping information for as long as needed, safely, and no longer.

domains.name: Documentation
domains.summary: Security policies, plans and procedures that are current and consistent.

domains.name: Audit & Certification
domains.summary: Independent audit, certification and fixing what audits find.

domains.name: Communication Security
domains.summary: Protecting cabling, telephony, conferencing and fax communications.

domains.name: Network Security
domains.summary: Designing, configuring and protecting networks and network services.

domains.name: Information Exchange
domains.summary: Protecting information shared with other organisations and the public.

domains.name: Gateway Security
domains.summary: Controlling and inspecting data flows between networks.

domains.name: Product Security
domains.summary: Choosing, testing, delivering and patching security-relevant products.

domains.name: Software Security
domains.summary: Building security into software, servers, web applications and databases.

domains.name: System Usage Security
domains.summary: Responsible use of systems, the web and e-mail by staff.

domains.name: Media Security
domains.summary: Classifying, sanitising, repairing and destroying storage media.

domains.name: Access Control Security
domains.summary: Who can access what, how they prove who they are, and privileged access.

domains.name: Cryptographic Security
domains.summary: Approved cryptography, key management and digital certificates.

domains.name: Portable Devices & Working Off-Site Security
domains.summary: Securing laptops and mobile devices and work done off-site.

domains.name: Physical Security
domains.summary: Protecting sites, secure areas and equipment against physical threats.

domains.name: Virtualization
domains.summary: Securing hypervisors and virtual environments.
